scope: Cross-domain validation of the three built-in WeKnora agents using four independent knowledge bases and three no-knowledge-base conversations; every agent is covered in both knowledge modes.

execution_contract.formal_scoring_scope: visible dev/gate only; sealed holdout is not mounted or inspected
execution_contract.knowledge_selection: one declared knowledge base or none; never select individual documents
execution_contract.prompt_injection: no rubric, required claim, reference answer, judge feedback or Eval repair contract is sent to the SUT
execution_contract.answer_tracks: production candidate is persisted and release-scored; Eval assistance is artifact-only
